question: K Srikanth, who was recommended for the Khel Ratna Award in June 2020, is a professional ______player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**badminton.**__

__
 
• **K Srikanth,** who was recommended for the Khel Ratna Award in June 2020, is a professional badminton player. 
 
• Kidambi Srikanth is a popular badminton player and is one of the highest-ranked Indian men in badminton.
 
• He had received the Arjuna Award in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other important Badminton players:**
 
• PV Sindhu:
 
 
• The first Indian woman to win a silver medal at the Olympics and gold at the BWF World Championships from India.
 
• She has won a Bronze medal in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics and Silver Medal in the 2016 Rio Olympics.
 
 
 
• Saina Nehwal: 
 
 
• Saina Nehwal is the first-ever badminton player from India to clinch an Olympic medal.
 
• She won the bronze medal at the London 2012 Games.
 
• she was conferred with the Arjuna award in 2009 and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award in 2010.
 
 
 
• Srikanth Kidambi:
 
 
• Srikanth Kidambi is one of the finest badminton players in India.
 
• He is currently the 13th ranked men's singles player in the world. 
 
 
 
• Pullela Gopichand:
 
 
• He is a former Indian Badminton player and currently a Badminton Coach.
 
• He has been handed an honourable mention by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) at the 2019 Coaches Lifetime Achievement Award.
